title: The WIN screen states 'You crossed into Marrowgate by the Keepers' old pilgrim stair, past St. Ashwyn's Perch, the quiet way,' but the status epilogue's own bullet list separately claims 'Last Light heard you went under the mountain on the Free Companies' word, not the crown's' -- two contradictory accounts of the same journey.
